items.stem: Why use PDO prepared statements with bound parameters?

options.text: They separate SQL from data, preventing SQL injection
options.rationale: Bound parameters are never interpreted as SQL, closing the injection vector.

options.text: They make queries run without a database connection

options.rationale: Prepared statements do not manage schema.

options.text: They convert all results to JSON
options.rationale: Fetch modes handle result shape, not JSON by default.
